module: Flowgraph node 'Mission Cleanup' (once_p_duration category). Cleans up the world state before a mission via the manager's mission module (processVehicles) with the options keepPlayer and keepTraffic (the player vehicle / traffic stay active instead of being stashed). Output: vehId, the id of the original player vehicle.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: Calls self.mgr.modules.mission:processVehicles{keepPlayer, keepTraffic} then writes vehId (original id or be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)).
